title: EN 10255 - Non-alloy Steel Tubes for Welding and Threading
description: Calculator for dimensions and weights of steel tubes according to BS EN 10255 standard. Select nominal bore size and tube weight class (Light, Medium, or Heavy) to retrieve corresponding specifications including outside diameter, wall thickness, and weight per meter.

outputs.formula: inputs.nominal_bore === '1/4' ? 13.6 : inputs.nominal_bore === '3/8' ? 17.1 : inputs.nominal_bore === '1/2' ? 21.4 : inputs.nominal_bore === '3/4' ? 26.9 : inputs.nominal_bore === '1' ? 33.8 : inputs.nominal_bore === '1 1/4' ? 42.5 : inputs.nominal_bore === '1 1/2' ? 48.4 : inputs.nominal_bore === '2' ? 60.2 : inputs.nominal_bore === '2 1/2' ? 76.0 : inputs.nominal_bore === '3' ? 88.7 : inputs.nominal_bore === '4' ? 113.9 : inputs.nominal_bore === '5' ? 0 : inputs.nominal_bore === '6' ? 0 : 0
